Two globe control valves (FV-200-05B and FV-200-05C) for HTF services in the Central Distribution.
Both valves have a design pressure of 600 psig and are classified as Class 1, Division 2, Group D hazardous area.
Valves operate with a flow rate of 1,650,000 lbm/h at an inlet pressure of 458.4 psia and outlet pressure of 320.4 psia.
The valves are manufactured by Flowserve and have a body material of ASTM A216 Gr. WCB with a bonnet material of A-216 WCB.
Valves include features such as live-loaded packing, graphite and grafoil packing materials, and a positioner from Logix 3000 Series.
Two globe control valves (FV-200-05D and FV-200-05E) for HTF recirculation.
Both valves have a design pressure of 600 psig and a temperature of 800°F.
Valves are manufactured by Flowserve with models VL/Std and Mark one.
They feature a globe body, standard pattern bonnet, and extended bonnet type.
Insulation is provided with a thickness of 6.5 inches.
The valves have a flow coefficient Cv of 84% for FV-200-05D and 68% for FV-200-05E.
Valves are tested under hydro pressure and leakage test is mandatory.
Material certificates and calibration certificates are required.
